description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule diff functionalities, including handling submodules that are not initialized, moved, or removed. It includes functions for adding files and committing changes, as well as a series of test cases verifying submodule behaviors.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds specified files to a given directory, commits them, and returns the short hash of the commit.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message including the provided arguments.
